Name: Sir Robert's Floral Bonanza
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial][b]Description[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]Behold a floral bonanza of pastel color, big bold blossoms and whimsical pots & vases for your decorating pleasure. Mix & match with my other mods to fulfill your dreams of having a houseful of flowers. [/font][/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]There are dahlias, cosmos, daisies and sunflowers. I love the sunflowers so much that I have 2 slightly different verions...one is facing you directly and the other is looking off to the side. Alas, I haven't been successful in creating a perfect marigold yet. [/font][/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]Please enjoy and happy decorating![/font][/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial][b]Installation instructions[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]Install the latest verion of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods. When you play the game, the images will be found in the Decor/Houseplant section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/font][/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial][b]Main features[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]There are 10 images via content patcher and each one has additional alternative textures in case you want to select a different vase or pot. [/font][/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]Images #1 through #10 can be placed comfortably on most end tables.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]Images #11 can be placed upon countertops, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34287]PC's Shabby Chic Kitchen[/url] by PlatinumCats or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541]Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras (AT)[/url] by lululovely.[/font][/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial][b]Requirements[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]Requires the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I also recommend using Happy Home Designer.[/font][/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial][b]Shout outs[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]All of the end tables featured in the pictures are by PlatinumCats and lululovely. I also used end tables from the furniture catalog in the game. The countertops are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34287]PC's Shabby Chic Kitchen[/url] by PlatinumCats and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541]LovelyKitchen Islands and Extras (AT)[/url] by lululovely.[/font][/size][/color]
